title.source: Recover an approval without its hash
title.text: 恢复缺少交易哈希的授权

explanation.source: Cancel the old approval by sending 0 USDC to your own wallet with the same nonce. This costs native USDC gas. It does not deposit money, enable a budget or revoke an existing allowance. The original approval may complete first.
explanation.text: 使用相同 nonce 向你自己的钱包发送 0 USDC，以取消旧授权。这会消耗原生 USDC gas 费用。它不会存入资金、启用预算或撤销已有授权额度。原始授权可能先完成。

feeRate.text: 每单位 gas 的最高费用（原生单位）

priority.source: Maximum priority fee per gas (native units)
priority.text: 每单位 gas 的最高优先费（原生单位）

maxFee.text: 最高 gas 费用（原生 USDC）

limitations.source: A higher-fee pending transaction may prevent this cancellation. Signed transactions do not expire on-chain. Only finalized nonce evidence unlocks the saved plan.
limitations.text: 费用更高的待处理交易可能阻止本次取消。已签名交易不会在链上到期。只有最终确认的 nonce 证据才能解除已保存计划的锁定。

consent.source: I approve this zero-value cancellation and its maximum gas fee.
consent.text: 我同意这笔零金额取消交易及其最高 gas 费用。

unavailable.source: Could not prepare cancellation. Check the connected owner wallet and network, then review again. The original remains held.
unavailable.text: 无法准备取消交易。请检查已连接的所有者钱包和网络，然后重新审阅。原始记录仍保持操作锁定。

pending.source: Cancellation is not finalized. Check the saved hashes; the original remains held. Review again only if you intend another cancellation with a new fee.
pending.text: 取消交易尚未最终确认。请检查已保存的哈希；原始记录仍保持操作锁定。仅在你确实打算支付新的费用再次取消时重新审阅。

submitted.source: Cancellation sent. Check finality before continuing; the original remains held.
submitted.text: 取消交易已发送。继续之前请检查最终确认；原始记录仍保持操作锁定。

check.text: 检查最终确认的取消交易

hash.text: 已保存的取消交易哈希

replaced.source: The old approval nonce is finalized as a replacement. The saved plan is released; no research budget was funded.
replaced.text: 旧授权的 nonce 已由替换交易最终确认。已保存的计划解除锁定；没有向研究预算注入资金。

original.source: The original approval finalized first. Review its status before continuing; no deposit was sent.
original.text: 原始授权先获得最终确认。继续之前请检查其状态；尚未发送任何存款交易。

circleUnsupported.source: Circle does not support this exact-nonce cancellation for Google wallets on Arc. Search Circle history for the existing transaction, then verify its hash on-chain. This does not sign or send another transaction. The original remains held until matching finalized evidence is verified.
circleUnsupported.text: Circle 不支持 Google 钱包在 Arc 上使用这种精确 nonce 的取消方式。请在 Circle 历史中查找现有交易，再在链上核验其哈希。此操作不会签名或发送另一笔交易。在匹配的最终确认证据得到核验前，原始记录仍保持操作锁定。

historyStatus.text: Circle 状态（不是结算证明）

historyEmpty.source: This page returned no transaction hashes. It does not prove the original was never signed or sent.
historyEmpty.text: 此页未返回交易哈希。这不能证明原始交易从未被签名或发送。

historyHeld.source: History inspection is read-only. The saved plan remains held until an exact finalized transaction is verified.
historyHeld.text: 历史检查仅为只读操作。在核验精确匹配且最终确认的交易前，已保存的计划仍保持操作锁定。

historyUnavailable.source: Circle history could not be inspected. Reconnect the same Google wallet if its signing session expired, then retry the read-only search. The original remains held.
historyUnavailable.text: 无法检查 Circle 历史。如果签名会话已到期，请重新连接同一个 Google 钱包，再重试只读搜索。原始记录仍保持操作锁定。

historyLimit.source: The history page limit was reached; the search is incomplete. The original remains held.
historyLimit.text: 已达到历史页数上限；搜索尚不完整。原始记录仍保持操作锁定。

fundingUnsupported.source: This Google wallet cannot sign the bounded Arc transaction required for a new deposit. No new funding attempt was started. Existing funds and recovery records are unchanged.
fundingUnsupported.text: 此 Google 钱包无法签名新存款所需的受限 Arc 交易。没有启动新的注资尝试。现有资金和恢复记录保持不变。
